Goods Receipt

The Goods Receipt view displays comprehensive details about items received into inventory from suppliers.

A goods receipt documents the physical receipt of inventory items, allowing you to track what has been delivered against purchase orders or purchase invoices.

From this view, you can edit receipt details, print the document for your records, or verify the quantities and items received against your purchase documentation.

The view shows key information including the receipt date, reference number, related purchase order or invoice numbers, inventory location, and supplier details.

To learn how to create or edit goods receipts, see: Goods Receipt — Edit
